span.p:
1. Verificar grados:
si grado P ≥ grado Q
→ dividir: P/Q = cociente + resto/Q

div.style: color: rgb(74, 44, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
2. Factorizar Q(x)
raíces reales → factores lineales
irreducibles → cuadráticos
repetidos → multiplicidades

div.style: color: rgb(74, 44, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
3. Descomponer:
P/Q = Σ Aᵢ/(x − rd)ᵏ +
Σ (Bⱼx + Cⱼ)/(x² + bx + c)ᵐ

div.style: color: rgb(74, 44, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
4. Resolver constantes A, B, C
por igualación de coeficientes
